Name: Wait Menu
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
[b][color=#ffff00]*[/color]If you [color=#00ff00]like[/color] my [color=#00ffff]mods[/color] consider [color=#ff0000]Endorsing[/color]![color=#ffff00]*[/color][/b]

Adds the ability to wait to pass time. From 30 minuets to 4 hours.

This does not just change the clock, it propels you [b]forward[/b] through the day. This mod will advance time by [b]relocating NPCs and advancing their schedules[/b].

Default trigger is [b]left ctrl + w[/b] which is changeable with GMCM.

The Menu is [b]controller friendly[/b].

Has a few other options in GMCM if you have it installed.

It is also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url].

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]

Manifest.Name: (TTG) Wait Menu
Manifest.Description: Adds a wait menu (30-minute steps up to 4 hours) opened with a configurable keybind (default Ctrl+W). Controller-friendly.
Manifest.Author: ThaleTheGreat
